Lead email sequences

Emails written around what each lead said in their form submission.

Email 1

Subject: quick thing before our call. Yo [Name], saw your answers, appreciate you being straight about where you’re at. no clear strategy is one of the most common ones I have heard…

A pre-call email that reflects the lead’s own answer back to them. It reframes “no strategy” as a missing system and closes with a student proof story.

Open doc ↗
JOJO emails

Subject: quick one before today. [Name], saw your answers before we hop on later. “I want to learn the skill, I don’t care about the money.” I don’t get to see those answers very often…

A pre-call series for a lead who feels stuck but can’t say why. It praises the right motive, then names the real gap.

Open doc ↗
Emails for Vegard

Subject: quick thing about your form. Hey [Name], saw your answers come through. One line stood out…

Picks one line from the lead’s form and flips a limit into a selling point: you need a system, not capital. A student story backs it up.

Open doc ↗
Emails

Subject: how [student] turned multiple payouts into a house. Hii [Name], saw you booked the call. Something I wanna share with you before that…

A booked-call email built on a single student transformation. It speaks to emotional trading habits and keeps the lead warm before the call.

Open doc ↗
Post call booking page

Subject: before we talk. [Name], your call is booked. Saw your answers. Good. Genuinely. Most of the people I end up working with have to undo bad habits…

A pre-call email for a complete beginner who wants freedom more than trading. It frames discipline as the harder half and ends on a first-payout story.

Open doc ↗
Email Sequence

Subject: hey, everything good? Hii [Name], just wanted to check in and make sure everything’s okay on your end. If something came up, totally understand…

A check-in sequence for leads who went quiet before booking. It warns against strategy-hopping and points back to the booking link.

Open doc ↗
8 day email sequence

Subject: you already know enough. Yo [Name], starting today, I’m sending you one video a day. Just one. Watch it, actually apply it, and we move to the next…

A day-by-day sequence that releases one video at a time. It cuts through information overload so leads apply before they consume more.

Video sales scripts

Long-form scripts that sell the mentorship.

VSL Script

Hook: You understand every concept, order blocks, FVGs, killzones. You excel when you trade sim, but when it comes to eval you can’t execute greens consistently…

A video sales letter that opens on the viewer’s exact execution problem. It argues the gap is behavior, not strategy.

Open doc ↗
VSL Mentorship

Pre hook: You’re here, that means you’re already serious. So don’t half ass this. Watch the whole thing…

A VSL with a pre-hook, hook and credibility section aimed at traders who keep blowing funded accounts. It sells the case for having a mentor.

Open doc ↗
Research

This is not gonna be like those hype/edited videos. If you’ve come to this page there can be two things: you’re interested, or you’re desperate to become profitable…

A raw script draft written for the viewer who is desperate to become profitable. It leans on the founder’s own years of failing and the need for accountability.

The $100K challenge

How a channel with no recent proof got some.

The problem

No recent proof

JD had no tangible recent results to show his audience.

The move

A $100K challenge

I had him take on a challenge: keep trading until $100K in profit is achieved, with one reel posted every day.

The payoff

Content with receipts

He hit $100,000 in profits in 22 days, in July 2026. Every day became a reel, and the results now feed his reels and YouTube videos.
